photo.alt: Satellite view of the Balkan Mountains

facts: Bordered by the Adriatic, Ionian, Aegean and Black seas
Highest point: Musala, 2,925 m, in Bulgaria
worth_knowing: The region is named for the Balkan Mountains, which run across Bulgaria. German geographer August Zeune coined the peninsula in 1808, wrongly thinking those mountains spanned the region.
